edges.reason: _msgSender() return value is assigned to the msgSender local in the Ownable constructor.
Deployer address stored in the msgSender local initialises _owner.
msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender().
Ownable constructor invokes _msgSender() before writing _owner.
onlyOwner compares the attacker controlled msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner reads _owner for the authorization require statement.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates withdrawTkn.
onlyOwner gates changeTknAddr.
onlyOwner gates changeSeriesFee.
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner.
owner() view returns the _owner state variable.
_tkn constructor parameter is assigned to the tkn state variable.
_name constructor parameter is assigned to Series.name.
OtoCorp constructor stores the payment token in tkn.
OtoCorp constructor sets tknSeriesFee to 0**18.
withdrawTkn executes the external tkn.transfer call.
withdrawTkn calls balanceTkn twice for the transfer amount and the event.
owner() result is used as the recipient of the token transfer.
tkn state variable is the callee of the external transfer.
External token transfer executes while the contract still holds the full balance and no state is updated beforehand, allowing a malicious token to re-enter withdrawTkn.
createSeries executes the external tkn.transferFrom call.
tkn state variable is the callee of the external transferFrom.
msg.sender is the payer of the series fee in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the mapping key used to push the new series address.
The newly deployed Series address is pushed into seriesOfMembers.
External transferFrom runs before the seriesOfMembers push and before the new Series is recorded, so a re-entrant token can reach createSeries in an inconsistent state.
createSeries deploys a new Series contract.
User supplied seriesName is passed into the Series constructor.
The deployed contract address is stored in the newContract local.
Contract creation executes the Series constructor.
newContract is the target of the external transferOwnership call.
msg.sender receives ownership of the newly created Series.
External call into the deployed Series reaches the inherited Ownable.transferOwnership.
changeTknAddr replaces the privileged tkn token reference.
newTkn parameter becomes the payment token used for fee collection.
Previous token address is captured in the oldTknAddr local for the event.
changeSeriesFee rewrites the tknSeriesFee state variable.
_newFee parameter is assigned to tknSeriesFee.
Previous fee is captured in the oldFee local for the event.
balanceTkn performs the external tkn.balanceOf call.
tkn state variable is the callee of balanceOf.
isUnlockTkn performs the external tkn.allowance call.
msg.sender is passed as the allowance owner.
tkn state variable is the callee of allowance.
mySeries reads the seriesOfMembers mapping.
msg.sender is used as the lookup key in mySeries.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the name state variable; fold it into the constructor core function.
Token address parameter is only used to initialise tkn inside the constructor.
seriesName is only forwarded to the Series deployment and needs no standalone node.
newTkn is consumed directly by the privileged token replacement logic.
_newFee is only written into tknSeriesFee by the fee setter.
newOwner is validated and stored directly by the ownership transfer function.
Local copy of _msgSender() used once to seed _owner in the constructor.
newContract exists only to receive the external transferOwnership call on the freshly deployed Series.
Temporary local holding the previous token address purely for the event emission.
Temporary local holding the previous fee purely for the event emission.
